label: Weibo
terms_note: Free after app review on open.weibo.com (普通接口 level; higher-level 高级接口 need application); statuses/share text ≤ 140 Chinese characters, may not contain #话题# and MUST contain at least one URL under the app's registered 安全域名; pic ≤ 5 MB JPEG/GIF/PNG; rate limits: 100 API calls per authorized user per app per DAY, 30 posts per user per HOUR, 15,000 calls per IP per hour; OAuth2 access tokens expire (test apps 1 day, approved apps 30 days).

tools.name: publish_image
tools.endpoint: same endpoint, multipart with `pic` (JPEG/GIF/PNG < 5 MB, one image)

tools.name: publish_video
tools.endpoint: — (no video endpoint on the v2 index; `statuses/share` takes one image)

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.endpoint: POST /2/comments/create.json (id, comment ≤ 140 汉字, pic_ids?, comment_ori?, rip)

tools.name: dm_send
tools.endpoint: — (no DM endpoints on the current v2 index)

tools.name: delete
tools.endpoint: POST /2/statuses/destroy.json (id) — “只能删除自己发布的微博”

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.endpoint: — (counts on the status object: reposts_count / comments_count / attitudes_count)

auth: 1. Register an app at open.weibo.com (developer identity review), set the **安全域名** (safe domain) — every shared
2. OAuth 2.0 authorization code → `access_token` (+ `uid`, `expires_in`; approved apps get 30-day tokens, test apps 1 day).
3. Interface levels: 普通接口 (default) vs 高级接口 (apply); statuses/share and comments/* are 普通.

endpoints.purpose: `status` (URL-encoded, ≤ 140 Chinese chars, no `#话题#`, MUST include a safe-domain URL), optional `pic` (multipart JPEG/GIF/PNG < 5 MB)

endpoints.call: POST comments/create.json` {id, comment}, `POST comments/reply.json` {id, cid, comment}

reference.limits: - 100 API calls per authorized user per app per **day**; posting 30 per user per **hour**; 15,000 calls per IP per hour (errors 10022 / 10023 / 10024); Weibo says limits are HTTP-polling oriented, not real time. - No third-party analytics endpoint (counts on status objects only). - 微博开放平台开发者协议 + content rules; the safe-domain URL requirement makes every API post a link post.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Weibo OAuth2 access_token, sent as the access_token parameter ('采用OAuth授权方式为必填参数'). For your own account use the developer authorization of your app (开发者授权, valid 5 years); ordinary user authorizations last 1 or 30 days depending on the app's level and cannot be refreshed server-side (refresh tokens exist only for the official mobile SDK) (https://open.weibo.com/wiki/%E6%8E%88%E6%9D%83%E6%9C%BA%E5%88%B6%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E).

config_fields.name: user_ip
config_fields.help: Real public IP of the operating user, sent as rip on statuses/share ('开发者上报的操作用户真实IP，形如：211.156.0.1').

adapter.terms: Per-app and per-user rate limits (error 10022 / 10023 / 10024, https://open.weibo.com/wiki/Rate-limiting); third-party shares must link to the app's registered safe domain.

me.note: account/get_uid returns {uid} of the authorized user (not counted against the rate limit).

publish_text.note: PUBLISHES a public Weibo through statuses/share ('第三方分享一条链接到微博'): `text` must be at most 140 Chinese characters, may not contain #话题词#, and MUST contain at least one URL on the app's registered safe domain (我的应用 > 应用信息 > 安全域名), otherwise Weibo rejects it. rip is config user_ip. No picture is sent (pic is a multipart upload). `id` is idstr; `reply_to` is ignored.

read_comments.note: comments/show?id={weibo id}&page&count returns {comments[{id, idstr, text, created_at ('Wed Jun 01 00:50:25 +0800 2011'), user{screen_name}, status}], total_number}.

read_mentions.note: statuses/mentions (@我的微博): `since` is a Weibo id (since_id), not a date. Weibo returns only posts by users who have also authorized this app ('只返回授权用户的微博'), so the list is partial.

delete.note: DESTRUCTIVE: statuses/destroy deletes one of the account's own Weibo posts ('只能删除自己发布的微博') and returns the deleted status.

analytics_post.note: statuses/count?ids= returns [{id, comments, reposts}] (counts as strings) for the one post id sent; likes and views are not part of this endpoint.

not_offered.publish_image: Pictures must be uploaded as the binary pic part of a multipart/form-data statuses/share request ('上传图片时...需要采用multipart/form-data编码方式', https://open.weibo.com/wiki/2/statuses/share); the runtime has no multipart upload and URLs are not accepted.
not_offered.reply_comment: comments/reply needs both cid (the comment) and id (the Weibo post) (https://open.weibo.com/wiki/2/comments/reply); the reply input carries only comment_id.

evidence: host api.weibo.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert, Inc.)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 6/6 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
